## Historical audit — H0086

**Scope.** This is a student coding trace, not a Scene task. Only chunk 2 of 3 is visible. The inferred goal is to persist and reuse an Igel feature schema across fitting and inference; the original task request is not visible. Source for the event citations below: **H0086**, `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/hint-codex-experiments/runs/codex_parallel_08/lanes/codex_parallel_08_lane1/codex_parallel_08_lane1_H_r1/infer_logs/igel-persist-feature-schema/turn_1/trajs.json`.

| Area | Observed evidence |
|---|---|
| Changes | Successful edits added schema-held standard/min-max scalers, reused them for inputs and targets, and re-raised preparation errors (main_agent events 48, 50, 52, 54, 56). A further edit saved `feature_schema.joblib` and feature metadata in the fit description (event 58). The code already visible in those edit observations loaded and applied a schema, but this chunk does not show when that earlier code was written. |
| Other changes | Evaluation was changed to use the specified model path; prediction and evaluation errors were re-raised. ONNX input width was changed from a fixed four to the training shape (events 60, 62, 64, 66). FastAPI was changed to return HTTP 400 for `ValueError` and clean up the temporary file (event 70). These are confirmed edit operations, not proof of runtime correctness. |
| Exploration and validation | The student checked imports successfully and inspected model names and Git change scope: three files, 145 insertions and 18 deletions at that point (events 72, 75–76). A self-directed fit/predict experiment reported selected inputs `['b', 'a']`, predictions approximately 5 and 7 with a reordered alias and extra column, and a detected conflicting alias (events 77–78). |
| Test result | The visible `pytest -q` run ended with two failures: expected test result/model files were absent, and export logged a missing description file (event 80, characters [0,6756)). This is a local test result, not an explanation of the separate formal failure. |
| Formal outcome | Supplied inventory metadata reports **partial correctness, formally not solved**: 23/24 fail-to-pass and 2/2 pass-to-pass tests. It reports an 18,280-byte patch, so this was not an empty patch. The failing formal test and its cause are not supplied; the evaluation file is linked but its contents are not visible. |
| Teacher input | No delivered teacher text or adoption evidence appears in this visible chunk. The inventory lists available hints and a captured-system-prompt path, but availability does not establish receipt; after-round review cannot be input to this round. Receipt and influence remain unknown. |

**Lessons and uncertainty.** The visible experiment illustrates a transferable distinction between saving transformation state and testing its reuse on reordered, aliased inputs; the alias-conflict behavior is specific to this implementation. A concrete unresolved hypothesis is whether the local failures stem from result-path configuration or code behavior: the logs show different `/app/model_results` and test-directory paths, but do not establish root cause. Neither those failures nor the successful smoke test identifies the formal failing case. Later edits, test outcomes, teacher receipt, and the final patch contents cannot be reconstructed from the unseen chunks.
